findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "find_entity" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Resolve a Greek buyer or supplier NAME to its ΑΦΜ. Use this first whenever you have a name but no ΑΦΜ — get_entity, entity_counterparties and the buyer_afm/supp…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.
